gloss: to consider; to take into account; in light of

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {鑑|かんが}みていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to consider; to take into account; in light of
definitions.explanation: To reflect upon past events, precedents, or circumstances and use them as a basis for judgment or action. A formal expression used in written and official contexts.

examples.japanese: {過去|かこ}の{事例|じれい}に{鑑|かんが}みる。
examples.english: To take past cases into consideration.

examples.japanese: {現状|げんじょう}に{鑑|かんが}みて、{計画|けいかく}を{見直|みなお}す{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: In light of the current situation, the plan needs to be reconsidered.

examples.japanese: {国際|こくさい}{情勢|じょうせい}に{鑑|かんが}み、{政府|せいふ}は{新|あら}たな{対策|たいさく}を{講|こう}じることを{決定|けってい}した。
examples.english: In light of the international situation, the government decided to implement new measures.

notes:
USAGE:
{鑑|かんが}みる is a formal, literary verb. It almost always takes the particle に: ～に{鑑|かんが}みる (in light of ~, considering ~). The conjunctive form ～に{鑑|かんが}み is frequently used in official documents and formal announcements.

COMMON PATTERNS:
Despite looking like it could be godan, {鑑|かんが}みる conjugates as an ichidan verb: {鑑|かんが}みる → {鑑|かんが}みて → {鑑|かんが}みた.
- ～に{鑑|かんが}みる (in light of ~)
- ～に{鑑|かんが}みて (considering ~ — te-form)
- ～に{鑑|かんが}み (considering ~ — formal conjunctive)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {事情|じじょう}に{鑑|かんが}みる (in view of circumstances)
- {前例|ぜんれい}に{鑑|かんが}みる (in light of precedent)
- {時代|じだい}の{変化|へんか}に{鑑|かんが}みる (considering the changes of the times)
